description.value: Chit Chat Burger Bar is a casual lounge-style gourmet burger bar on downtown Vancouver's Granville Street, founded by Aldo Velaj with a commitment to fresh, locally sourced ingredients. The menu features hand-crafted burgers on brioche buns alongside creative loaded fries, tacos, salads, and house-made milkshakes and ice cream. An extensive cocktail list and rotating BC craft draft beers make it a lively spot for cyclists passing through the heart of the city.
